research_title: CHED HUSAY Program (Continuing Professional Development Studies Grant)
reason: HUSAY/CPDSG funds faculty upskilling short courses and microcredentials for active HEI personnel—not undergraduate student bursaries. Official CHED page lists faculty nomination workflows for Thailand/AIT and MMSU programs.

research_title: SDG Research Development and Innovation Grant (SDG-RDIG)
reason: Competitive research funding instrument for multi-institutional HEI consortia aligned with UN SDGs (CMO No. 2 s. 2026)—not an individual student scholarship. CHED program page states details to be released.
